content.intro: This lesson covers filtering groups with having as part of SQLite’s embedded relational database model. Work through one small example, verify the output, and then connect the result to the listed subtopics from the supplied curriculum.
content.why_it_matters: Function names can look familiar while returning results affected by SQLite-specific storage and version rules.

items.title: WHERE versus HAVING
items.text: Aggregate functions summarize groups. WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups. Remember that aggregates generally skip NULL inputs and verify how COUNT(*) differs from COUNT(column).

content_blocks.title: Example: Filtering Groups with HAVING
content_blocks.code:
WITH expense(category, amount) AS (VALUES ('food', 5), ('books', 12), ('food', 7))
SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM expense GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
